description: Source code for initializing Atmel SAMD MCU series clocks and peripherals in Zephyr OS environment.

methods.name: osc8m_init
methods.description: Initializes the 8MHz internal oscillator and configures GCLK0 to use it.

methods.name: osc32k_init
methods.description: Initializes the 32kHz external oscillator if enabled in configuration.

methods.name: xosc_init
methods.description: Initializes the external crystal oscillator based on configuration.

methods.name: xosc32k_init
methods.description: Initializes the 32kHz external crystal oscillator based on configuration.

methods.name: dfll48m_init
methods.description: Configures the DFLL48M clock generator if not using default main clock.

methods.name: flash_waitstates_init
methods.description: Sets flash wait states based on configuration.

methods.name: gclk_main_configure
methods.description: Configures GCLK0 to use the DFLL48M clock.

methods.name: osc8m_disable
methods.description: Disables the 8MHz oscillator if configured to do so.

methods.name: z_arm_platform_init
methods.description: Initializes all clock sources and peripherals for the platform.
